steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Can we who have superhuman powers and knowledge ever be accepted by human society?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: No. Humans will see us as heretics and monsters. They want to expel us, imprison us, and destroy us.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Because... nothing arouses the most primitive fear in the human heart more than the unknown.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Little one, we're here. This is the WhiteSands Shelter.
Stargazer leads you inside the shelter.

All of a sudden, all the whispering around you stops. People in the shelter gather on opposite sides, with their heads bowed, seemingly unwilling to communicate with you. They sneak glances at you, but once you meet their eyes, they avert their gaze.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Yes, they're afraid.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Perhaps if you announce your affiliation with Quinn, they will be welcoming towards you. After all, Quinn's generosity is well-known in this area.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Too bad you're with me.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What does that mean?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Haha... what does that mean...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: It means you are affiliated with heresy.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Dispelling sandworms, traveling through sandstorms, and returning alive from the Tide of Ashes...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: There's no one who wouldn't fear such a... monster.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Don't say that. I don't think you're a monster.
Upon hearing your words, Stargazer chuckles.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: I'm glad you are willing to speak out on my behalf.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: However, did you ever stop to think... that perhaps you think this way because...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: You're a monster, too?
Stargazer comes up to your ear and answers you in a hushed tone that only you can hear.
Her warm breath is laced with that exotic fragrance. It encircles your ears, causing you to tremble.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Haha, don't worry. I never care what those people think of me.
Stargazer smiles unconcernedly and turns to walk out of the shelter.
You turn to follow her, but a gush of whispers from the crowd stops you in your tracks.

steps.speaker: Refugee in Shelter
steps.content: Do you see that? The monsters from WhiteSands really listen to her...

steps.speaker: Refugee in Shelter
steps.content: The monsters don't kill her. Does that mean... she's a monster, too?

steps.speaker: Old Man in Shelter
steps.content: Cough cough, watch your mouth. People are listening.
Stargazer is right. These people regard her as a "heretic."

steps.speaker: Old Man in Shelter
steps.content: Judging from your attire, you must be from DisCity.
An old man in rags blocks your path.

steps.speaker: Old Man in Shelter
steps.content: You're the first and only person I've ever met who speaks to the great Stargazer. Are you not afraid of her?

steps.speaker: Old Man in Shelter
steps.content: She's often accompanied by the monsters from WhiteSands, and can even control those monsters!

steps.speaker: Old Man in Shelter
steps.content: And her eyes are so strange! Some say that when you look into her eyes, she will bewitch and control you!

steps.speaker: Old Man in Shelter
steps.content: Oh! And that crystal ball she always carries around! Even though her prophecies are never good...

steps.speaker: Old Man in Shelter
steps.content: Foreseeing the future is not something anyone can do!

steps.speaker: Old Man in Shelter
steps.content: Many say that she turns those who approach her into the monsters in WhiteSands!

steps.speaker: Refugee in Shelter
steps.content: Hmph! So she's on the side of the monsters! She's the one who brought the Tide of Ashes!

steps.speaker: Old Man in Shelter
steps.content: Watch your mouth! Don't poke trouble with your careless words!

steps.speaker: Old Man in Shelter
steps.content: DisCitizen, take my advice. Don't get too close to Stargazer, or else you might also turn into a soulless monster!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Thank you for your... kind advice.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But I hope you get to know Miss Stargazer yourself before passing judgement.
The old man looks at you and sighs. Realizing that he can't convince you to stay away from Stargazer, he waves his hand to disperse the crowd.
The shelter returns to its usual calm. You rush to catch up with Stargazer.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: You're back? Heard what you wanted to hear?
These somewhat frosty words burrow into your ears. Stargazer is still smiling, but you feel that she is now a bit guarded towards you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I just heard a few things about you, like how much you seem to like WhiteSands.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: That's right.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I often had a recurring dream before coming to WhiteSands.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: In that dream, I stand in the middle of a white desert, caught in a sandstorm. But I don't feel afraid because at the end of the dream, a pair of hands always rescues me from the sandstorm.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Hence... when the corporation wanted someone to explore WhiteSands for business opportunities, I volunteered to take up the job.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Hestia pats that little battered messenger bag she carries.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: ...Though you are beloved by WhiteSands, will you choose it in return? Will you leave the human world?
You have no immediate answer, and sink deep into thought.
The sound of heavy cannon fire abruptly snaps you back to your senses. Not far away, the fleeing desert bandits has reassembled and are launching another attack on the shelter.
Countless bullets and shells rain down. You subconsciously step in front of Stargazer to protect her.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Little one, are you trying to protect me? There is no need to be afraid of them at all, we will be fine...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Because, your companions shall come save you.
As soon as her voice falls, a black shadow zips before your eyes, destroying the desert bandits' ship.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Nightmare?! It's Hecate!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey! And me!
A familiar sand ship comes into view. A petite figure leaps from it, knocking out the desert bandit trying to approach you.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, don't just stand there! Get ready to beat the crap out of these desert bandits with me!
